scope: same immutable original feature packet, empirical prior, tariffs and control source; NOT transfer to new sources
compile: all supported histories reachable under each frozen optimal policy; reject missing and unregistered states
numerics: inherited float64 Planner with TOL1e-12; independent Fraction audit; no learned approximation
costs: one actual512-update prior per formal run; one compilation and load per run; per-method attribution shown separately; all physical work counted once
break_even: descriptive constant-marginal-cost extrapolation only; null when measured marginal saving is nonpositive
